input.title: Only render pending bullet after cursor touches thought
input.body:
- [ ] Depends on #1978

Thoughts are usually loaded before the user has the chance to interact with them, so we may as well create the illusion that they have loaded instantly. Showing them as pending for a half second actually creates the perception of slower load times.

The only contraindication is for thoughts that are expanded once their children load. They probably should be shown as pending, but there is no way to determine if they will be expanded or not ahead of time.

## Steps to Reproduce

Add `await sleep(2000)` to [replicateChildren](https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/c21cdc17813b6fe06f2e112cfc56693a34ed8b4a/src/data-providers/yjs/thoughtspace.ts#L739) to simulate a slow connection. 

## Current Behavior

Bullet is animated with a pulsing animation while its thought's children are pending.

## Expected Behavior

When the cursor touches a thought, set `touched: true` on the thought. Only render the pending animation on thoughts that have been touched.
